spans.s:
अकृच्छ्र अ-कृच्छ्र, अस्, अम्, m. n. absence
of difficulty; facility.
अ-कृच्छ्रिन्, ई, इणी, इ, free from trouble.

अकृत अ-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, undone, un-
performed; not made, uncreated; not prepared, not
ready, incomplete; one who has done no works;
(अम्), n. an unperformed act; an unheard-of action
or crime; (आ), f. a daughter not placed on a level with
sons.
—अकृत-कारम्, ind. as has not been done be-
fore.
—अकृत-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, ungrateful.
—अकृत-
ज्ञ-ता, f. ingratitude.
—अकृत-बुद्धि, इस्, इस्, इ,
having an unformed mind.
—अकृतबुद्धि-त्व,
अम्, n. ignorance.
—अकृत-व्रण, अस्, m., N. of
an expounder of the Purāṇas.
—अकृतात्मन् (˚त-
आत्˚), आ, आ, अ, having an unformed mind; not yet identi-
fied with the supreme spirit.
—अकृतार्थ (˚त-अर्˚),
अस्, आ, अम्, having one's object unaccomplished unsuc-
cessful.
—अ-कृतास्त्र (˚त-अस्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, unpractised
in arms.
—अ-कृतैनस् (˚त-एन्˚), आस्, आस्, अस्, innocent.
—अकृतोद्वाह (˚त-उद्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, unmarried.

अकृत्त अ-कृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, uncut, unimpaired.
—अकृत्त-रुच्, क्, क्, क्, possessing unimpaired splendor.

आ-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. brought near to; being
near.

अ-कृतिन्, ई, इनी, इ, unfit for work, clumsy.
—अकृति-त्व, अम्, n. unfitness for work.

अकृत्रिम अ-कृत्रिम, अस्, आ, अम्, inartificial,
unfeigned, natural.
अकृत्स्न अ-कृत्स्न, अस्, आ, अम्, incomplete.
अकृप अ-कृप, अस्, आ, अम्, merciless, unkind.
अकृपण अ-कृपण, अस्, आ, अम्, not miserly.

अकृश अ-कृश, अस्, आ, अम्, not slender or
emaciated; strong, full.
—अ-कृश-लक्ष्मी, ईस्, ईस्, इ,
enjoying full prosperity.
—अ-कृशाश्व (˚श-अश्˚), अस्,
m., N. of a king of Ayodhyā.

अकृषीवल अ-कृषीवल, अस्, आ, अम्, not
agricultural.

अकृष्ट अ-कृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, unploughed,
untilled; not drawn.
—अकृष्ट-पच्य, अस्, आ, अम्,
ripening in unploughed land, growing wild.

आ-कृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, drawn, pulled, attracted.
—आकृष्ट-मानस, अस्, आ, अम्, distracted in mind.
—आकृष्ट-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, pulling, dragging, pull-
ing up or out; pulling to, attracting; charming,
fascinating.

अकृष्णकर्मन् अ-कृष्ण-कर्मन्, आ, आ, अ, free
from black deeds, guiltless, virtuous.

आकृ आ-कृ, cl. 8. 5. P. -करोति, -कृणोति,
-कर्तुम्, to bring near or towards, to bring down,
to make or form wholly; to drive near to or together:
Caus. P. -कारयति, -यितुम्, to ask any one (acc.)
for anything (acc.); to invite to a place, to call into
existence, to cause to appear: Desid. -चिकीर्षति,
to intend to accomplish: Intens. -करिक्रति, 3rd pl.,
Ved. to attract repeatedly towards one's self.

आकॄ आ-कॄ, cl. 6. P. -किरति, -करितुम् or
-रीतुम्, to scatter or sprinkle over, fill, fill up, give
abundantly, cover, replenish, heap up, accumulate.

आ-कृति, इस्, f., Ved. a constituent part; form, figure,
shape, appearance, aspect; character, specimen; the
body; tribe, species; a metre consisting of four lines
with twenty-two syllables to each line.
—आकृति-गण,
अस्, m. a list of specimens, a collection of words belong-
ing to a certain grammatical rule, which does not ex-
hibit every word belonging to that rule, but only speci-
mens; whereas a simple Gaṇa exhibits every word;
(explained by native authorities to mean a list of words,
the fact of a word belonging to which can only be
determined by observing the forms used by classical
authors.)
—आकृति-च्छत्रा, f. the plant Achyranthes
Aspera.
—आकृति-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having shape, em-
bodied.

आकृष् आ-कृष्, cl. 1. P., 6. P. A. -कर्षति,
कृषति, -ते, -कर्ष्टुम् or -क्रष्टुम्, to draw
towards, attract, put on, draw away; to bend (e. g.
चापम्, a bow); to draw or tear off, draw out of;
to withdraw, deprive of, take away; to borrow: Caus.
-कर्षयति, -यितुम्, to draw near to one's self.

आ-कृष्टि, इस्, f. attracting, drawing near, bending
of a bow.
—आकृष्टि-मन्त्र, अस्, m. an incantation
by which another person is attracted.

आ-कृष्य, ind. having drawn, extracted, pulled or
dragged.

आ-कृष्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being drawn or at-
tracted.
